dashboard.admin.steps.category.descripti: Categories decide which agents receive a chat, for example Sales or Support.
dashboard.admin.steps.widget.title: Design your widget
dashboard.admin.steps.widget.description: Pick the colors, greeting messages and topics visitors can choose from.

dashboard.admin.steps.embed.description: Copy one script tag into the pages where visitors need help.
dashboard.queue.title: Live queue

dashboard.team.title: Team

auth.login.title: Log in to your account
auth.login.description: Enter your email and password below to log in
auth.login.portal_description: Use the email and password of your Auth Portal account.
auth.login.portal_hint: Admin and agent access is managed in the portal. If you cannot get in, ask a portal administrator.
auth.no_chat_access.title: No chat access
auth.no_chat_access.body: Your credentials are correct, but this account is not an admin or an agent here. Ask an administrator to give you access.
setup.brand.subtitle: Installation
setup.stepper.label: Setup progress
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to :app
setup.welcome.description: A few quick steps and your support chat is ready. First we check that this server can run it.
setup.token.title: Confirm setup access
setup.token.description: Enter the one-time setup token so nobody else can claim this server.
setup.token.label: Setup token
setup.token.hint: It is printed once in the application log at startup (with Docker: docker compose logs app) and set as SETUP_TOKEN.
setup.env.title: Environment check
setup.env.locked: The environment check appears once the token is verified.
setup.env.all_ok: Everything this server needs is in place.
setup.env.one_failed: One check needs attention before you can continue.
setup.env.some_failed: :count checks need attention before you can continue.
setup.mode.title: How will people sign in?
setup.mode.description: This choice is locked once setup finishes.
setup.mode.fortify.title: Starter kit auth
setup.mode.fortify.description: Accounts live in this app. Email and password with two-factor and passkeys. Admins manage agents here.
setup.mode.pizzasys.title: Auth Portal (pizzasys)
setup.mode.pizzasys.description: People sign in through your organization's Auth Portal. Admin and agent access comes from the portal's roles.
setup.admin.title: Create the first admin
setup.admin.description: This account manages widgets, agents and settings.
setup.admin.name: Full name
setup.admin.password_hint: Choose a long, unique password. It is hashed before it is saved.
setup.basics.title: App basics
setup.basics.description: You can change all of this later in Settings.
setup.basics.app_name_hint: Shown in the dashboard and in emails.
setup.basics.app_url_hint: The address people use to reach this app, including https://.
setup.basics.idle_timeout_hint: Chats close automatically after :minutes minutes without messages. Default: 120.
setup.basics.idle_timeout_range: Use a whole number from :min to :max.
setup.run.title: Install
setup.run.description: Review the details, then start. Every step can be repeated safely.
setup.run.summary.title: What will be set up

setup.run.error.forbidden: The setup token is not verified for this session. Reload the page and verify it again.
setup.run.error.conflict: Another setup run is in progress. Wait a moment, then retry.
setup.run.error.session_expired: Your session expired. Reload the page, then retry.
setup.run.error.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then retry.
setup.run.error.invalid_response: The server sent an unexpected answer.
setup.done.title: You're all set
setup.done.description: Setup is complete. Sign in to open your dashboard.
